sources.title: The pulvinar as a hub of visual processing and cortical integration
sources.authors: Cortes N, Ladret HJ, Abbas-Farishta R, Casanova C

sources.title: Transthalamic Pathways for Cortical Function
sources.used_as: transthalamic pathway architecture; layer 5 driver vs layer 6 modulator; GABA gating

sources.title: Gating and control of primary visual cortex by pulvinar
sources.authors: Purushothaman G, Marion R, Li K, Casagrande VA
sources.used_as: causal evidence: muscimol inactivation (−64% V1 response), bicuculline activation (+232% center, −83% surround); LGN independence

sources.title: Attention gates visual coding in the human pulvinar
sources.used_as: human fMRI evidence: attention gates position encoding (attended yes, ignored none); orientation gating; stronger than V1-MT+
sources.notes: 开放全文。PMID:22968697。唯一人类直接枕叶注意编码证据之一。

sources.title: Modulation of pulvinar connectivity with cortical areas in the control of selective visual attention
sources.used_as: pulvinar weights excitatory signals to cortical areas when cue+distractor present; priority map construction

sources.title: Context-dependent attentional spotlight in pulvinar-V1 interaction
sources.authors: Chen N, Ai H, Lu X
sources.used_as: pulvinar initiates information reweighting to V1 in cluttered scenes; focused attention enhances pulvinar-V1 correlations

sources.title: The dorsal lateral geniculate nucleus and the pulvinar as essential partners for visual cortical functions
sources.used_as: LGN (first-order) vs pulvinar (higher-order) comparative framework; pulvinar connectivity with all visual areas

sources.title: Pulvinar-Cortex Interactions in Vision and Attention
sources.authors: Zhou H, Schafer RJ, Desimone R
sources.used_as: pulvinar inactivation: task performance 74.3%→10.8%, V4 −60%; V4 slow-wave state; gamma coherence directionality

sources.title: Pulvinar Modulates Synchrony across Visual Cortical Areas
sources.authors: Cortes N, de Souza BOF, Casanova C
sources.used_as: LP inactivation: area 21a gamma +103% (layer IV); alpha feedback (21a→17) weakened; gamma feedforward (17→21a) coordinated

sources.title: Dynamic pulvino-cortical interactions in the primate attention network
sources.authors: Kastner S, Fiebelkorn IC, Eradath MK
sources.used_as: theta-rhythmic attentional sampling in pulvinar; alpha synchronization of V4/TEO in delay period; Granger causality: pulvinar→cortex predominant

sources.title: Impaired attentional selection following lesions to human pulvinar: Evidence for homology between human and monkey
sources.authors: Snow JC, Allen HA, Rafal RD, Humphreys GW
sources.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA
sources.used_as: clinical lesion evidence: baseline discrimination normal, distractor competition impaired; increasing target salience normalizes performance
sources.notes: 开放全文。PMID:19237580。关键人类临床证据。
